discount_offers.data_policy: Vercel AI Gateway has a ZDR policy and does not retain prompts, outputs, or sensitive data. User data is immediately and permanently deleted after requests are completed. No action is needed on the user side. AI Gateway has agreements in place to offer ZDR with specific providers. A provider's default policy may not match with the status that AI Gateway has in place due to these agreements. By default, AI Gateway does not route based on the data retention policy of providers. If we do not know a provider's ZDR stance or have not yet established an agreement with them, they are treated as not being ZDR-compliant.

discount_offers.training_use: No training on prompt data is available to all AI Gateway users at no extra charge. This feature ensures your prompts are not used by AI providers to train their models.
